verdict.rationale: Yubico's python-fido2 library explicitly verifies FIDO attestation signatures, and java-webauthn-server implements the Relying Party registration operations. PIV attestation certificates prove a key was generated on the device. Together these cover verifying attestation at registration, but nothing shows how to enforce an allowlist of approved key models. Missing for 10: documented model/AAGUID allowlisting or metadata-based policy enforcement, Yubico attestation root CA guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of attestation-gated enrollment.
